description: CMS Medicare Physician Fee Schedule payment policy indicators for all codes on the fee schedule
source: CMS National Physician Fee Schedule Relative Value File -- PPRRVU2026_Jul_nonQPP.csv
note: Full 8-indicator MPFS payment policy data (restored -- a prior rebuild of this file collapsed everything to just global_days_int to match an older simple schema, which lost mult_proc/bilat_surg/asst_surg/co_surg/team_surg/pctc_ind/endo_base entirely). Indicator values are CMS raw strings (e.g., '010' not 10) to preserve alignment with CMS documentation; global_days_int is a convenience field for code that just wants an integer, but XXX/YYY/ZZZ/MMM all collapse to 0 there -- use the raw global_days string for anything that needs to distinguish those cases (e.g. ZZZ add-on codes should follow their base procedure's global period, not default to 0). mult_proc is CMS's own multiple-procedure payment adjustment indicator and should take precedence over modifier_51_exempt.json (AMA Appendix E) for Medicare-specific claims -- CMS's claims processing system applies its own hard-coded logic per this field, which doesn't necessarily match the CPT book convention. Codes with -26 and -TC modifier variants are consolidated to the base (blank-modifier) row; pctc_ind conveys whether PC/TC split applies.

indicator_meanings.status: A=active, B=bundled/not separately payable, C=carrier-priced, I=not valid for Medicare, N=noncovered, R=restricted coverage, T=paid if no other service on same day, X=statutory exclusion
indicator_meanings.global_days: 000/010/090 = numeric postop days; XXX = concept doesn't apply; YYY = contractor-priced global period; ZZZ = add-on code, follows base procedure's global period; MMM = maternity code
indicator_meanings.pctc_ind: 0=physician service (no PC/TC split), 1=diagnostic test/PC-TC split possible, 2=professional component only, 3=technical component only, 4=global test only (no PC/TC split), 5=incident-to service, 6=lab physician interpretation, 8=physician interpretation excluded, 9=concept does not apply
indicator_meanings.mult_proc: 0=no adjustment, 1=standard 50% reduction rules apply, 2=standard 50% reduction rules apply (different base), 3=special rules for endoscopic base procedures, 4=diagnostic imaging reduction rules, 5=therapy reduction rules, 6/7=diagnostic cardiovascular/ophthalmology reduction rules, 9=concept does not apply
indicator_meanings.bilat_surg: 0=150% payment adjustment doesn't apply, 1=150% adjustment applies, 2=bilateral adjustment doesn't apply/inherently bilateral, 3=bilateral base for other rules, 9=concept does not apply
indicator_meanings.asst_surg: 0=payment restriction applies (assistant rarely used), 1=statutory payment restriction (assistant almost never used), 2=payment restriction doesn't apply, 9=concept does not apply
indicator_meanings.co_surg: 0=not permitted, 1=permitted if supporting documentation, 2=permitted (no documentation required), 9=concept does not apply
indicator_meanings.team_surg: 0=not permitted, 1=permitted if supporting documentation, 2=permitted (no documentation required), 9=concept does not apply
indicator_meanings.endo_base: the base endoscopy code family this code belongs to, if applicable
